gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological verification of glioblastoma and CA 12-expression of tumor cells confirmed

candidate_evidence.quote: Locoregional, intracavitary radioimmunotherapy (iRIT) with a newly developed radioimmunoconjugate (Lu-177 labeled 6A10-Fab-fragments) will be used to prevent or postpone tumour recurrence in patients with GBM following standard therapy .

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Primary supratentorial high grade glioma after standard therapy (fluorescence-guided surgery, radio-chemotherapy, concomitant + adjuvant chemotherapy), with no or stable small tumor residue (residual contrast enhancement of up to 5cm3) at earliest 6 weeks after completion of radiotherapy
Determine maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and safety of adjuvant radio-immunotherapy (RIT) with Lu-177 labeled 6A10-Fab-fragments

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Evaluation of pharmacokinetics of Lu-177 labeled 6A10 Fab fragments: Determining absorbed dose to the 2 cm shell of the resection cavity (based on a series of SPECT/CTs of the head 2 ,24 ,48, 72 hours post injection and on day 5-7).

role_evidence.quote: The antibody 6A10 is a specific CA12 Inhibitor, a highly specific glioma cell-associated enzyme; all tumor cells are CA12-positive
The patient will receive a predetermined dose of Lu-177-labeled- 6A10Fab-fragments via the intracavitary reservoir.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational lutetium-177 (Lu-177) labelled anti-carbonic anhydrase XII antibody Fab fragment (LuCaFab), intracavitary radioimmunotherapy
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: carbonic anhydrase XII (CA12)-targeted delivery of Lu-177 beta radiation to tumour cells around the resection cavity

biomarkers.biomarker_other: carbonic anhydrase XII (CA12) expression in tumour cells

source_quote.quote: Histological verification of glioblastoma and CA 12-expression of tumor cells confirmed

coder_notes: Radiopharmaceutical: isotope Lu-177 recorded in drug_class_hint; moiety named by ligand without isotope (no INN in record; development name 6A10 Fab, also called LuCaFab). Treatment setting coded newly_diagnosed because treatment is adjuvant after completed standard chemoradiation with no or stable residue, to prevent recurrence, although the record uses 'after standard therapy' (C10 would otherwise suggest recurrent). tumour_pk_planned coded yes on the basis of SPECT/CT-based dosimetry of the cavity margin explicitly labelled pharmacokinetics; this is imaging of tumour-region drug distribution rather than tissue/CSF sampling. CA12 expression is an entry requirement and is the target of the candidate antibody, so candidate_matched true.
